name: SEO Broken Links
description: A worker that fixes broken links in formatted-text fields using a URL shortener service.
project_description:
SEO Broken Links - a module uses the Google Shortener service to fix the broken links from the Formatted Text fields on the Content Entities.

 How to install? 
 - Install the SEO Broken Links module as you would normally install a

 contributed Drupal module. Visit https://www.drupal.org/node/1897420 for

 further information.

 How to configure? 
 After the module is installed:

 - Follow the path "/admin/config/services/seo-broken-links-settings".

 - Add the Google Access token key & check the "Activate google shortener

 converter upon node submit?" in order to make it work on node submit.

 How to use? 
 - If you have activated it to be used on Node Submit, the urls will be fixed on Node save event.

 - Follow the path "/admin/config/services/seo-broken-links-bulk" to fix manually the

 links from the other content entities those have Formatted Text fields.
